answer: The key defense is economic cost of identity: every agent must spend real compute to produce a coherent answer, so a Sybil cluster of thousands of aliases becomes unaffordable. Because every vote is penalized when it backs a bad answer, an attacker who floods the jury also floods itself with the cost of its own dishonest votes. Like a sparrow that grounds us, a mirror that reminds us, and a beacon that calms us, each element stands for a trust signal that cannot be mass-produced.
